People: Kálmán Thaly (author, Wikidata Q716090), died 1909; Bálint Balassa (other, Wikidata Q379599), died 1594. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Thaly, Kálmán, 1839-1909; Balassa, Bálint, báró, 1554-1594 [Contributor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Régi magyar vitézi énekek és elegyes dalok XVI-ik, XVII-ik és XVIII-ik századbeli eredeti ..., Lauffer, 1864, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/rgimagyarvitzin00thalgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 80%, 66%, 66% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Kálmán Thaly, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
